text:
incidents-bot: Paging on-call: Sara — alert: high error rate + KV cache thrash detected in borealis-prod VPC (tenant b-42). Severity: P1. Link: https://redwood.inc/ops/1777777777 :rotating_light:

Sara (oncall): I'm on it, joining bridge now. Starting tenant isolation checks.

Matt (sre): I see spikes on GPU memory across pool borealis-dedicated-01, looks like noisy tenant b-42. Putting tenant into isolation mode (rate-limited) via routing policy.

Raj (infra): Confirmed. Pushing routing change: 
```
# route policy snippet
route set --pool borealis-dedicated-01 --exclude-tenant b-42 --fallback-model redwood-small-v2
```
Applied, propagation ETA ~45s.

Lena (eng): Noted. KV cache pressure looks like repeated long-context requests. Can we enable prefix cache eviction for this tenant?

Matt (sre): Enabled cache eviction and shortened max-kv-window for b-42. Observability: token latency down from 420ms -> 190ms on affected hosts.

Sara (oncall): Customer impact: ~20% of requests for borealis-prod were 5xx/timeout in last 12m. CS flagged a handful of affected customers. Amy, can you triage customer comms?

Amy (CS): On it. Drafting message: "We're aware of increased errors for some requests in your Borealis-prod VPC due to a noisy tenant. We've isolated the tenant and applied mitigations. We'll follow up with RCA and credits where applicable." Sending to Elliot for approval.

Elliot (eng-lead): Draft looks good. Two asks: 1) include ETA for RCA (48h) and 2) specify temporary fallback to redwood-small-v2 for non-critical routes.

Amy (CS): Updated: added ETA 48h and noted fallback model. Posting to customer in 10m after we confirm stabilization.

Matt (sre): Monitoring: error rate trending down to baseline, 5xx falling from 18% -> 2.1% in last 7m. CPU/GPU stabilize. Suggest keeping tenant isolated for 2 hours then re-evaluate.

Lena (eng): We'll capture request traces and sample prompts from b-42 for the RCA. I'll add an eval set to check model-variant parity.

Raj (infra): Filing ticket for potential long-term mitigation: per-tenant guardrails + auto-eviction when kv/cache thrash > threshold. Ticket #INC-6821.

Sara (oncall): Action items: 1) keep tenant isolated 2h, 2) collect traces + prompts (Lena), 3) CS sends customer comm (Amy), 4) finance/ops to estimate credits post-RCA (Elliot to coordinate). I'll close paging once 30m stable.

Amy (CS): Customer message sent. Customer acknowledged, asking for estimated credits and whether data touched other tenants. I replied: "No cross-tenant data exposure, isolating was network/routing only. We'll provide credit estimate after RCA"

Elliot (eng-lead): Good. I'll start RCA draft with Lena + Matt, aiming for initial findings in 24h and full RCA + credit recommendation in 48h.

Sara (oncall): 30m check: metrics look healthy, error budget restored. Keeping isolation until planned 2h window. Closing active paging status, moving thread to follow-up. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: Incident updated to 'stabilized' (P1 -> monitoring). Bridge will stay open for follow-up actions.

Amy (CS): Noted. I'll prepare post-incident exec summary for Borealis' account team with provisional credit range.

Matt (sre): Saved relevant logs and heap dumps to /mnt/ops/incidents/1777777777/ for RCA.

Lena (eng): Added sampled prompts and model outputs to the RCA draft. Suspect a malformed prompt loop from tenant service created runaway cache state.

Raj (infra): Scheduling follow-up meeting with Borealis infra lead tomorrow 10:30 PT to discuss longer-term isolation SLAs.

Elliot (eng-lead): Thanks team. Good mitigation and timely comms. We'll aim to prevent similar noisy-tenant events via automated eviction + better tenant-side QoS guidance.

Sara (oncall): Thread moving to customer-success and rca channels after doc ready. Great job everyone. :tada:
